title: Prime Minister shares article on moving governance from welfare to empowerment
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared an article written by Union Minister, Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia.
The article highlights how India’s approach to governance is moving from welfare to empowerment, enabling citizens to become active participants in the development process. It notes that initiatives spanning sanitation, gas connections, healthcare and access to credit focus on last-mile delivery and creating opportunities for people to improve their lives. This approach is central to the vision of a Viksit and Sashakt Bharat by 2047.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X;
“Union Minister Shri @JM_Scindia writes that India's approach to governance is shifting from welfare to empowerment. It is enabling citizens to become active participants in the development process.
From sanitation and gas connections to healthcare and access to credit, the focus is on last-mile delivery and creating opportunities for people to improve their lives. This approach is central to the vision of a Viksit and Sashakt Bharat by 2047.”
